extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4. Multi-country Communication covering ten enlargement countries: only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, e-government, e-services, broadband, roaming, workers, social security, EURES, interoperability, electronic, data protection, connectivity, information society, technology) and full reading of every page with a hit, including the North Macedonia conclusions (paragraph 9, page 20), the thematic Annex 1 (pages 28-43) and the digital part of Annex 2 on the Economic and Investment Plan (pages 45-46). Annex 3 (Eastern partners) and Annexes 4 and 5 (statistics) contain nothing on North Macedonia in scope. Period covered left empty: the register gives none. Left out: cybercrime passages (R21); passages on Ukraine, Moldova and Georgia; WBIF digital projects naming only Serbia and Albania; a general reference to Innovation Agenda cooperation on digitalisation and cyber-security (page 47), judged incidental. The document gives two different target years for near-domestic EU roaming prices (2027 at page 13, 2028 at page 46). No Chapter 2 material found. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
